title: Make Git doctor topology-aware across project and memory repos
description: Audit cluster from F-004 and F-018: Git doctor inspects one worktree and hard-codes memory paths instead of reading project topology.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor inspects project and memory repos separately using .boreal/project.json topology.
Sibling, child, in-repo, shared, separate, and submodule modes yield explicit diagnostics instead of hard-coded memory assumptions.
Tracked generated artifacts are reported against the correct repo boundaries.
closedReason: Implemented and verified in sprint bw_work_30c5438d99da6ce6.
